operating_notes.text: Luxury portfolio delivered sales value of INR 475 crores in FY26.
Magic Moments volume reached 8.6 million cases with around INR 1,500 crores in sales value during FY26.
FY2026 total IMFL volume reached 38.33 million cases, up 22.2% YoY.
Magic Moments vodka holds over 60% market share of the Indian vodka category, which rose from 4.6% of IMFL in Q1FY26 to 6.1% in Q1FY27.
Total ENA requirement is around 28–30 crore litres against captive production of 33 crore litres across Rampur, Sitapur and the JV.
Exports are about 5–6% of volume, present in over 100 countries and 63 travel retail outlets, with a target of 100 airports.
Q2FY27 consolidated revenue from operations reached ₹5,582.71 Cr with net profit at ₹232.35 Cr.
Magic Moments vodka market share is ~60% of the Indian vodka category.
Vodka penetration in India is 6.3% of IMFL as of H1 FY27.
Strategic inventory build-up of grains to mitigate price volatility.
DRI visited corporate office in New Delhi and Rampur manufacturing facility as part of an industry-wide exercise under the Customs Act, 1962.

timeline.summary: Abhishek Khaitan, Promoter, declared no substantial share acquisition by Promoters/PAC during FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Radico Khaitan reported FY26 net revenue of ₹6,050.4 Cr and net profit of ₹602.5 Cr, supported by strong premiumisation.
Radico Khaitan Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹9 per equity share (450% of ₹2 face value) for FY2025-26, pending AGM approval.
Radico Khaitan hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 7, 2026, outlining FY27 guidance including 25% luxury growth and debt-free status by H1 FY27.
NCLT Allahabad Bench ordered the dispensation of meetings for the amalgamation of Radico Khaitan's eight wholly owned subsidiaries.

Radico Khaitan's Q1FY27 call (July 29, 2026) reported revenue of ₹1,684 Cr, EBITDA of ₹348 Cr at a record 20.7% margin, raised FY27 P&A volume guidance to over 25% and reiterated net debt free by Q2FY27.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹5,582.71 Cr (+10.4% YoY), net profit ₹232.35 Cr (+66.5% YoY).
Radico Khaitan reported Q2FY27 net revenue of ₹1,745 Cr with 36% growth in premium volumes and raised its FY27 P&A volume growth guidance to 30%.
On October 27, 2026, Radico Khaitan disclosed that DRI officials visited its corporate and registered offices as part of an industry-wide exercise.

status_history.evidence: NCLT issued order dated June 01, 2026 dispensing meetings of shareholders and creditors.
Q1FY27 P&A volume grew 36% against the 20% FY27 target; full-year outcome pending.
